future_leakage.answer: No material future leakage detected within tested E1 cold forecast-boundary paths.
future_leakage.uncertainty: TRAIN/VAL selected paths only; not a proof for every possible deployment path.

past_only_representation_helped_predicti.answer: Not established. In Jena d16 DIAG_SUBSET two seeds, Bolt/PREFIX was worse than latent ridge and reference-latent diagnostic.
past_only_representation_helped_predicti.uncertainty: Only Jena d16 subset, two seeds; d320/Robin not adopted here.

delayed_cross_channel_useful.answer: Mixed. Jena real VAL improved with ALL lag vs SELF, Robin worsened; synthetic changed/fixed show small repeated gains and unrelated false positives.
delayed_cross_channel_useful.uncertainty: VAL reuse; E2 is diagnostic, not independent generalization.

where_problem_remains.answer: Representation/future-latent prediction and decoder/readout both remain suspects.
where_problem_remains.uncertainty: Reference latent is a diagnostic using future latent labels, not deployable performance.

contrastive_or_dynamic_graph_needed.answer: Not supported by adopted E5/E6 evidence. E5 balanced small run favored reconstruction objectives over contrast/forecast; E6 failed before condition results due NaN JSON serialization.

E6_status_observed.failure_reason: Out of range float values are not JSON compliant: nan

contrastive_or_dynamic_graph_needed.uncertainty: E5 is small fixed-budget; E6 has no valid condition metrics yet.

keep_chronos_bolt.answer: Current adopted evidence does not provide a strong reason to keep Chronos-Bolt for this path.
keep_chronos_bolt.uncertainty: This is a Jena d16 diagnostic subset conclusion, not a final model-choice proof.

uncertainties: No protected TEST file was read; conclusions are TRAIN/VAL diagnostics only.
